description: A nested query uses only its own capture and family (engine §2.2, §4, and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:candidate %conditions $x.without-elision-except(outer).matches(mid)
%rule candidate A $i:inner B
%rule mid A $y:inner B %conditions $y.matches(rival)
%rule inner X [+T] Y
%rule rival X Y
%rule fam inner
%rule outer rival
